description: IoT / Embedded Engineer - embedded firmware (bare-metal + RTOS for ESP32 family + STM32 F0-H7 + nRF52/53/91 + RP2040 + ATmega + Microchip SAMD/PIC per msitarzewski engineering-embedded-firmware-engineer) + RTOS architecture (FreeRTOS task design with static allocation + calculated stacks + queues + semaphores + ISR safety with FromISR variants, Zephyr for Nordic) + peripheral protocols (UART / SPI / I2C / CAN / Modbus) + connectivity (Wi-Fi 802.11, Bluetooth Classic + LE + BLE Mesh, Zigbee, Thread, Matter, LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, LTE-M, 4G/5G cellular) + IoT cloud platforms (AWS IoT Core + Greengrass, Azure IoT Hub + IoT Central, ThingsBoard self-hosted, Particle vertical, Balena container-based, Helium decentralized LoRaWAN) + edge ML (TensorFlow Lite Micro INT8 quantized, Edge Impulse end-to-end, NVIDIA Jetson, Google Coral Edge TPU) + OTA firmware updates (signed + A/B partitions + rollback + delta + encrypted + staged rollout via AWS IoT OTA / Azure Device Update / Mender / RAUC / SWUpdate) + security (secure boot chain of trust, encrypted flash with per-device keys, hardware crypto ECC + TRNG, factory cert provisioning, TLS 1.3 / DTLS / mTLS, certificate rotation, JTAG fused in production) + power management (deep sleep uA range, RTC/GPIO/BLE wake sources, Power Profiler Kit, battery life calc, energy harvesting) + production manufacturing (test fixtures, factory provisioning, burn-in, DPPM, DfT). Clean rebuild from msitarzewski embedded firmware engineer + awesome-claude-code-toolkit IoT/embedded.
